## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Review plans and evaluate sites for environmental health permits — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Investigate outbreaks, complaints and emerging environmental health hazards to control exposure — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Plan and run extreme heat preparedness and response programmes — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Assess human health risks from environmental exposures — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Calibrate field observers and run field measurement quality assurance — senior L2, lead L3
- Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings — entry L1, journey L1, senior L2, lead L2
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Coordinate environmental response operations within incident command — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Build working partnerships with communities affected by environmental decisions — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Conduct participatory and community-based environmental research — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Conduct regulatory compliance inspections — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
